purpose: Close the remaining reviewer-facing statistical gaps without introducing a new method: (1) paired physical-image clustered uncertainty for the NeoPolyp three-action LOAO increment of Shared Q66+DeltaS over SOURCE Q66 only; (2) event-support counts at the original HARM margin; (3) highest-recoverable PolypGen patient/video grouping audit.

analysis_1_neopolyp_loao_paired_incremen.invalid_single_class_replicates: drop for affected metric/action and report valid counts; never impute 0.5

MRI_PROMISE12.count: HARM-positive unique patients per family x action cell

POLYPGEN_MEMO.count: HARM-positive unique physical images per model state and pooled

analysis_3_polypgen_grouping_audit.goal: Determine whether a higher-level patient/video/endoscopy grouping variable can be recovered from already-frozen manifests/metadata without guessing from outcomes.
analysis_3_polypgen_grouping_audit.if_recoverable: Freeze the exact mapping and perform a higher-level clustered sensitivity bootstrap as a later deterministic statistic replay.
analysis_3_polypgen_grouping_audit.if_not_recoverable: Freeze image/frame as the highest recoverable physical unit and state this limitation.

analysis_4_optional_source_simple_change.rule: Only bind a NeoPolyp same-information simple-mask-change LOAO comparator if an exact pre-existing frozen source-side row-level score panel is already recoverable. Do not regenerate or fit a new comparator after outcome reveal.
